description: Communauté d'Agglomération Plaine Vallée: wastewater datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté d'Agglomération Plaine Vallée. Coverage: Communauté d'Agglomération Plaine Vallée. The listing groups 8 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about wastewater; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Affectat résultat 2019 au BS 2020 Assainissement; Adhésion Charte Nationale Qualité réseaux assainissement 2020; Affectation résultat 2018 au BS 2019 Assainissement - 2019; Redevance assainissement 2021. Formats seen: WEB PAGE. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
